title: Gentle Hub card banner for streambeats-player
brief: Card icon/banner for the Gentle Hub listing (gentle-hub-project topic): the card icon resolves from the FIRST image of the README, so we need a static SVG-safe banner (1280x400) that reads BOTH as hub card icon (small crop) and as README head. Brand identity comes from the repo's own theme palettes (internal/theme/theme.go artboardPalettes): vinyl amber #e8a33d, synthwave magenta #ff5ec8, quiet ink blue #7aa2f7, over the dark panel base.

artboards.title: Vinyl disc
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest product motif (the vinyl record reads at any size, even 64px without text); the turntable scene is warmer than the rest of the README's terminal look

artboards.title: Synthwave panel
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the actual product (mini TUI panel with list rows, transient keycaps and the playing bar), drawn geometry-safe for SVG; busier and less iconic at small crop

artboards.title: Quiet wordmark
artboards.tradeoff: Most scannable at small sizes and cleanest next to the gentle-ai badge; carries the weakest product identity (wordmark first, tool second)
